title: Custom Furniture & Private House Renovation | DUMSKAYA
description: A DUMSKAYA DESIGN project: design and production of custom furniture and turnkey renovation of a private house. Photos of the completed project.
h1: Custom furniture design and turnkey renovation of a private house

blocks.text: Custom furniture design and turnkey renovation of a private house

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) completed the custom furniture design and production, as well as the turnkey renovation of this private house.

The custom furniture was designed and manufactured for all areas of the house, including the living room, bedroom, kitchen with tailored storage solutions and built-in appliances, walk-in closets, entryway, bathroom, cabinets, and shelving.
Each piece of furniture was individually designed to complement the architecture and interior of the house, maximize functionality, and meet the client’s specific needs, preferences, and lifestyle.

Special attention was given to efficient storage solutions, carefully selected materials, proportions, finishes, and the integration of built-in appliances. This approach created a cohesive interior in which the furniture forms an integral part of the overall living space.
The turnkey renovation included the coordination and implementation of construction and finishing works, furniture installation, lighting, plumbing, and other essential interior elements.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) provides custom furniture design and production, interior solutions, and turnkey renovation services across Slovakia, Europe, and the USA.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN — interiors that come to life.
